strategies.name: Hierarchical two-level reduction
strategies.desc: Exploit multi-node structure by first reducing within each node (intra-node all-reduce), then across node leaders (inter-node all-reduce), then broadcast back within nodes. For 224 ranks this could be 8 nodes × 28 ranks/node. Increases total dispatches (3× per logical all-reduce step) but each has smaller communication diameter and may pipeline better.

strategies.name: Pipelined vector-scalar interleaving
strategies.desc: Reorder operations to issue the vector all-reduce for iteration i+1 immediately after computing buf for iteration i, allowing overlap of the expensive vector communication with cheap local mean computation. Still 8 vector + 8 scalar operations but with better latency hiding through careful dispatch ordering and potential async execution.

strategies.name: Reduce-scatter + all-gather decomposition
strategies.desc:
Replace each all-reduce(sum) with reduce-scatter followed by all-gather, splitting the 8*2048 tensor into 224 chunks. The reduce-scatter produces partial sums, compute mean on the local chunk, then all-gather reconstructs full vector. 16 dispatches (8 RS + 8 AG) but each moves 1/224 of data in RS phase, trading off latency for bandwidth efficiency.
